475792259.author: Sasha Turner
475792259.text:
One Star — Absolutely Unacceptable

I have genuinely never had a hotel experience this appalling.

We arrived to find that our room had not been cleaned at all. The previous guests’ dirty bedding was still on the bed, tissues were left around the room, and the toilet was dirty. This wasn’t a minor oversight — the room had quite literally not been serviced. In addition to this, we heard other guests having the same issue as they complained at the same time we did.

Things somehow got even worse when we returned later. The room was 33°C, with absolutely no air conditioning. The windows had blockers fitted to them so they could only be opened by a tiny amount — not even enough to properly get your fingers through — meaning there was effectively no way to cool the room down.

We were eventually offered a fan in the middle of the night, after repeatedly going down to the reception and calling the mobile number multiple times, only to discover that the fan didn’t even work.

At that point, the room was so unbearably hot that we had no choice but to leave our room and sleep in the hotel lobby.

Let that sink in: we paid to stay in a hotel room and ended up sleeping in the lobby because the room was too hot to sleep in, after being given a room that hadn’t even been cleaned and a fan that didn’t work.

This wasn’t a slightly disappointing stay. It was an absolute failure from start to finish. Basic cleanliness, basic comfort and basic customer service were all completely lacking.

I would strongly advise anyone considering staying here to think twice. Paying for a hotel room should not mean having to clean up after previous guests, endure 33°C temperatures with no functioning way of cooling the room, and ultimately sleep in the lobby.

Quite possibly the worst hotel experience I’ve ever had. Avoid.

1507876.author: Supriti Sujay
1507876.text:
This is a really good accommodation, but the reason I am giving it only a 2-star rating is because of their EXTREMELY LOW HYGIENE LEVELS.
1. Rats everywhere. There were rats in my kitchen, and every night I would see them running about the courtyard. This is the most serious hygiene breach and a serious health hazard.
2. There is absolutely no protocol for bad hygiene standards in the kitchen. If you get bad flatmates, good luck, because the staff really don't care. They will give you a warning, and you have to hope that your flatmates will clean up for the inspection. I have had people leave their half-eaten food out for weeks until mould formed, and I had to throw it out myself.
3. Nobody cleans the elevators or the common spaces. I have seen garbage bags left open outside the bin in the common kitchen area, and nobody has come to take them out for days. The elevator always stinks of trash, and my corridor space was absolutely disgusting. They do not have enough cleaning staff, and when they do come once a week, they barely do the basics.
4. The rugs in the common area smell horribly, especially in the summer. No idea when they were last cleaned or if they were ever cleaned at all.
5. MAGGOTS in the fridge. A friend of mine had maggots in her kitchen because some meat was left out, and the Canvas staff did not pay to have it removed. My friend had to get it done themselves and pay for it too! While the contract states that the private spaces are to be taken care of by us, the flat's kitchen is still a common space, and no one person can be held responsible for several others who share the flat. Additionally, it is the building owner's responsibility to ensure basic hygiene is maintained to address health concerns.

Every time I have complained to the front desk, they have taken no action. They really don't care. There are certain things which are acceptable in student accommodation, but serious problems such as rats and maggots absolutely cannot be tolerated. The rent isn't cheap either!

While I loved my spacious room and bathroom as well as the common areas such as the study spaces, I was let down by these major issues. I wish I could say my time in Canvas was perfect because of the lovely aesthetics, but ultimately the negatives outweigh the positives, and if I could, I would just rent an individual apartment in a better part of town than stay in a place like this ever again.
